statement.zh: 尼普尔乌尔第三王朝伊南娜神庙的运作与组织，见 Zettler 1992（BBVO 11）基于发掘与档案的研究。
statement.en: At Nippur, the Ur III Inanna temple’s operation and organization are studied from excavation and archival evidence in Zettler 1992 (BBVO 11).
